world_security.summary: Debate about dominance of permanent five members could reignite if major powers block Costa Rican frontrunnerThe race to become the next UN secretary general could reach a decisive moment on Friday when a UN security council vote is likely to reveal whether the Costa Rican frontrunner for the post would be blocked by the big powers.
